Learning Objectives


01 Understand the benefits of version control.


02 Know where to find help when setting up Git and GitHub on your computer


03 Understand the concept of: stage (add), commit, push, pull, clone


04 Work with GitHub repositories from the command line, RStudio, Visual Studio Code, Positron… (wherever you do your coding)
